organic_results.title: Migration Guide - Pydantic Documentation
organic_results.snippet: In Pydantic v2, BaseSettings has been moved to a separate repository and package: pydantic-settings. Instead of importing from pydantic, use: from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings. BaseSettings is no longer included in the root pydantic module.

organic_results.title: pydantic-settings - PyPI
organic_results.snippet: Settings management using Pydantic, separated from Pydantic V2 core. Install with pip install pydantic-settings and import from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings.

organic_results.title: Settings Management - Pydantic Docs
organic_results.snippet: Pydantic v2 settings management documentation. If you were using BaseSettings in V1, notice that in V2 it was removed from core pydantic and moved to pydantic_settings.

organic_results.title: pydantic/pydantic GitHub Releases - v2.0.0
organic_results.snippet: Breaking changes in v2.0: BaseSettings moved to pydantic-settings. Generic models syntax overhauled. Root validators deprecated.
